metadata.question: Did Vietnam have more active fire detections than Myanmar on February 3, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use global active fire point detections (prefer VIIRS 375 m, fallback to MODIS MCD14DL), filter to 2018-02-03 and to Vietnam/Myanmar polygons from FAO GAUL 2015 level0.
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (point detections). No cloud masking needed.
3. Validity logic: If the selected fire dataset returns zero features globally for the day (after trying both VIIRS and MODIS), output C1. Otherwise, zero counts in a country are valid (not C2). Catch runtime/dataset errors and output D. No calculations that could yield NaN, so C3 unlikely.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(v);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const dateStart = '2018-02-03';
    const dateEnd = '2018-02-04';
    const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0');
    const vn = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Viet Nam')).geometry();
    const mm = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Myanmar')).geometry();

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Fallback
    const tryDatasets = [
      'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT', // VIIRS 375 m NRT points
      'MODIS/061/MCD14DL',              // MODIS Thermal Anomalies (pts) C61
      'MODIS/006/MCD14DL'               // MODIS Thermal Anomalies (pts) C6 (legacy)
    ];

    let chosenFC = null;
    let chosenId = null;
    let globalCount = 0;

    for (const ds of tryDatasets) {
      try {
        const fc = ee.FeatureCollection(ds).filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd);
        const sz = await getInfoAsync(fc.size());
        if (sz > 0) {
          chosenFC = fc;
          chosenId = ds;
          globalCount = sz;
          break;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Try next dataset
      }
    }

    if (!chosenFC) {
      console.log(`Date: ${dateStart}`);
      console.log('Datasets tried: ' + tryDatasets.join(' | '));
      console.log('No fire detections found globally for this date.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: Country counts
    const vnCount = await getInfoAsync(chosenFC.filterBounds(vn).size());
    const mmCount = await getInfoAsync(chosenFC.filterBounds(mm).size());

    // 4. Evidence output (concise)
    console.log(`Date: ${dateStart}`);
    console.log(`Dataset: ${chosenId}`);
    console.log(`Global detections: ${globalCount}`);
    console.log(`Vietnam detections: ${vnCount}`);
    console.log(`Myanmar detections: ${mmCount}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (vnCount == null || mmCount == null) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (vnCount > mmCount) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
